sources.title: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
sources.snippet: We introduce PInVerify, an offline embodied benchmark for AIV: 3,000 evaluation episodes across 18 categories, realized as multi-view captures over a 6-sector navigation graph, with protocol-level annotations (trap views, unreachable sectors, stratified positive / neg_same / neg_diff pairs) absent from upstream navigation datasets (§ 4). 3.

sources.title: [2605.30639] PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active ...
sources.snippet: We formalize AIV as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce PInVerify, an offline embodied benchmark for AIV: 3,000 evaluation episodes across 18 object categories, delivered as multi-view captures with a 6-sector navigation topology that exposes trap views (navigable but uninformative) and unreachable sectors.
